mandate_recherche.intro: The European answer to the buyer's agent. You entrust us with the mission of finding your future property and overseeing its acquisition, in Luxembourg or abroad. Under exclusive mandate, in your sole interest.
mandate_recherche.highlight_1_title: Advice that serves only one master
mandate_recherche.highlight_1_text: We defend exclusively your buyer's interest. No double agency.
mandate_recherche.highlight_2_text: Activation of our network of confidential partners in France, Luxembourg, UAE, Spain, etc.

mandate_recherche.when_title: When to choose the search mandate
mandate_recherche.when_text: You don't have the time or the network to identify the ideal property yourself, or you are looking abroad (where market opacity is high). You want advice that defends exclusively your interest, not a broker serving two masters.
mandate_recherche.advance_p1: Every search mandate carries a fee advance, fully deducted from our fees if the transaction concludes with MAPA Property.
mandate_recherche.advance_p2: Luxembourg: €250 excluding VAT. Neighbouring regions, up to 100 km: from €500 excluding VAT. Other countries: by quotation, depending on the travel required.
mandate_recherche.advance_p3: Why this advance: a search mandate commits us to working exclusively on your project. We stop offering the properties we identify to other buyers, we activate our network, we visit and qualify before presenting anything to you. This time is real, it precedes any transaction, and it cannot be free. The advance formalises this mutual commitment: you commit to a defined project, and we commit our resources to it.

about_page.title: Real estate isn't sold. It's entrusted.
about_page.intro: MAPA Property: Luxembourg real estate agency and international broker. Under mandate, within a framework, in your sole interest.
about_page.para_1: MAPA Property brings together two partners who have practised real estate for nearly ten years, and an agency founded in Luxembourg in 2024. Our backgrounds in finance taught us the discipline of the verified detail and the value of discretion. These two principles shape the way we work.
about_page.para_2: We work under mandate, for a single interest at a time. This is the Anglo-Saxon buyer's agent model: when we represent a buyer, we defend that buyer alone, from the search through to signing. When we represent a seller, we defend their price and their terms. Our clients sense this clarity from the very first conversation.
about_page.para_3: Artificial intelligence is part of our everyday toolkit. It helps us cross-reference market data, spot properties before they come to market, and structure an analysis in a few hours where it once took days. But no algorithm walks through a door in our place, reads a room, or senses what is really at stake in a negotiation. Technology saves time. Judgement remains ours.
about_page.para_4: A significant part of our activity never appears anywhere. Confidential sales, off-market properties, bespoke searches: we operate away from the shop window, because that is exactly what our clients come to us for. arcova.title: ARCOVA · the MAPA Property private access
arcova.intro: ARCOVA is the confidential space reserved for qualified clients under MAPA Property mandate: complete off-market files, confidential proposals and secure exchanges, by invitation only.
arcova.problem_text: In premium real estate, the bulk of high-value transactions are negotiated privately, outside the public market: close to two-thirds of high-end operations go through private and advised channels rather than open listings. But without a common framework, this so-called "confidential" market is rarely confidential in practice: a single property circulates from network to network, by email and messaging, through multiple intermediaries within weeks. The owner loses control of distribution, the price drifts with each intermediary, the property's characteristics end up diverging from one version to another. There is neither traceability, nor protection, nor recourse in case of a leak.
arcova.consequences_item_1: Price inflation: each intermediary adds their margin, and the displayed price drifts away from the real one.
arcova.consequences_item_2: Information drift: surface, rooms, land, sale terms diverge from one version to another.
arcova.consequences_item_3: Reputational damage: to the owner as much as to the mandated professional.
arcova.consequences_item_4: Over-exposure: the property paradoxically becomes more visible than a public listing.
arcova.consequences_item_5: Limited conversion: qualified buyers have already received several contradictory versions.
arcova.consequences_item_6: No recourse: without a contractual framework, neither evidence nor protection in case of a leak.
arcova.valuation_text: Conversely, a truly controlled and confidential off-market property is better valued: private prestige transactions close with a meaningful premium compared to publicly marketed equivalents. Properly protected confidentiality is an asset, not a weakness.
arcova.response_text: ARCOVA enforces a qualified and traceable access protocol. Each member is verified (KYC/AML) and signs a contractual NDA before any access. Each file becomes a unique time-stamped reference; each consultation is logged. The confidentiality of the property, the control over its distribution and the interest of each party are protected end to end.
arcova.protect_title: What ARCOVA protects, for each profile
arcova.protect_owners_text: real and contractually protected confidentiality, full control over distribution, protection of the sale price, access to an international network of qualified buyers.
arcova.protect_brokers_text: preserved reputation, unique and consistent file version, protected commission, reduced bypass risk.
arcova.protect_buyers_text: access to genuinely off-market properties, reliable and verified information, end-to-end secure transactions, protective legal framework.

agency.title: Real estate agency in Luxembourg
agency.meta_description: MAPA Property, a real estate agency in Luxembourg founded in 2024: sales, purchases, lettings and search mandates across the Grand Duchy, under signed mandate.
agency.answer: MAPA Property is a Luxembourg real estate agency founded in 2024. It handles the sale, purchase and letting of properties across the whole Grand Duchy, with a strong presence in the centre, south and west of the country. The agency only works under a signed mandate, for a single interest at a time, and extends its work abroad as an international broker.
agency.faq_q1: Where does MAPA Property operate in Luxembourg?
agency.faq_a1: Across the whole Grand Duchy, with a strong presence in the centre, south and west. The city pages describe the markets the agency follows.
agency.faq_a2: They are public and quoted excluding VAT (17%). For a sale: 3% of the net seller price with an exclusive mandate, 4% semi-exclusive, 5% simple and 1% autonomous. The full scale, including lettings and search, is on the Fees page.
agency.faq_q3: Can the agency act without a mandate?
agency.faq_a3: No. MAPA Property only acts under a signed mandate and defends a single interest at a time: that of the seller or of the buyer who appointed it.
agency.faq_q4: Can I have my property valued?
agency.faq_a4: Yes. The indicative online valuation is free. A valuation with a visit and a written report is free as part of a potential sale mandate, and quoted otherwise.
agency.faq_q5: In which languages is the website available?

buy.title: Buying property in Luxembourg
buy.meta_description: Buying in Luxembourg: listed properties, waiting list, search mandate and Off-Market. Purchase costs, Bëllegen Akt and financing simulators.
buy.answer: To buy a property in Luxembourg with MAPA Property, you can browse the properties listed for sale, join the waiting list to receive new properties 24 hours before they are published, or sign a search mandate. With a search mandate, the agency searches for you, including off-market, and defends only your interests as a buyer through to the notarial deed.
buy.faq_q1: What costs should I plan on top of the price?
buy.faq_a1: In Luxembourg, allow about 6% registration duties, 1% transcription duty and about 1% notary fees, an indicative total close to 8% of the price.
buy.faq_a2: A tax credit on registration duties of up to 40,000 euros per buyer for the purchase of a main residence, with no age or first-time buyer condition (law of 3 July 2025).
buy.faq_q3: How can I access properties that are not listed?
buy.faq_a3: The Off-Market selection is available on a reasoned request, after signing a non-disclosure agreement. A search mandate also activates the agency's confidential network.
buy.faq_a4: The borrowing capacity and financing simulators give a first indication using Luxembourg market rates. The final decision rests with the bank.

sell.meta_description: Selling in Luxembourg with MAPA Property: valuation, four sale mandates from 1% to 5% excluding VAT, marketing, negotiation and follow-up to the deed.
sell.answer: To sell your property in Luxembourg with MAPA Property, you start with a valuation, then choose one of four sale mandates: exclusive (3% excluding VAT of the net seller price), semi-exclusive (4%), simple (5%) or autonomous (1%). The agency then handles marketing, buyer selection, negotiation and follow-up through to the notarial deed.
sell.faq_q1: Which sale mandate should I choose?
sell.faq_a1: The exclusive mandate entrusts the sale to MAPA Property alone, at the lowest rate of the three full mandates. The semi-exclusive mandate lets you introduce buyers from your own circle. The simple mandate lets you list with several agencies. The autonomous mandate lets you handle viewings and negotiation yourself, with legal and notarial support.
sell.faq_q2: How long does a mandate last?
sell.faq_a2: From two months, the duration recommended by MAPA Property. It renews tacitly and can be terminated with 15 days' notice.
sell.faq_a3: On signature of the notarial deed, unless otherwise agreed in writing. Rates are excluding VAT (17%), on the net seller price.
sell.faq_a4: The indicative online valuation is free. A valuation with a visit and a written report is free as part of a potential sale mandate, and quoted otherwise.

rent.meta_description: Renting in Luxembourg with MAPA Property: find a rental, let your property or entrust its management, within the 5% legal rent cap.
rent.service_name: Lettings and property management in Luxembourg
rent.answer: MAPA Property helps you rent in Luxembourg both ways: find a rental among the listed properties, or let your property with tenant selection and a compliant lease, with optional property management. The rent always respects the Luxembourg legal cap of 5% of the invested capital per year.
rent.faq_a1: One month's rent excluding VAT, shared according to custom (50% landlord, 50% tenant) or paid entirely by the landlord, depending on the mandate.
rent.faq_q2: How much does property management cost?
rent.faq_a2: From 6% to 8% excluding VAT of the rents collected, depending on the services included: collection, service charges, claims and end of lease.
rent.faq_q3: What is the maximum rent allowed in Luxembourg?
rent.faq_a3: The annual rent may not exceed 5% of the capital invested in the dwelling (law of 21 September 2006 on residential leases).
rent.faq_a4: Through a careful review of a complete file, with identity and anti-money laundering checks (KYC), before a compliant lease is signed.

search.meta_description: MAPA Property search mandate: the agency finds your property in Luxembourg or abroad and defends only your interests. Fees from 3% to 5% excluding VAT.
search.answer: A search mandate entrusts MAPA Property with finding the property you are looking for and managing its purchase, in Luxembourg or abroad. The agency defends only your interests as a buyer. In Luxembourg, its fees are 3% to 5% excluding VAT of the purchase price, with an advance of 250 euros excluding VAT, deducted from the fees if the purchase completes.
search.faq_q1: How much does a search mandate cost?
search.faq_a1: In Luxembourg, 3% to 5% excluding VAT of the purchase price. In Europe, including France, 3% to 8% excluding VAT depending on complexity and country. Elsewhere, quoted in the mandate.
search.faq_q2: What is the fee advance for?
search.faq_a2: It formalises the mutual commitment: the agency works exclusively on your project. It is 250 euros excluding VAT in Luxembourg, from 500 euros excluding VAT in neighbouring regions up to 100 km, quoted elsewhere, and fully deducted from the fees if the transaction completes with MAPA Property.
search.faq_q3: Does the search include off-market properties?
search.faq_a3: Yes. The mandate activates the agency's confidential network: partner agencies, direct owners and off-market sources.
search.faq_a4: Yes. MAPA Property operates directly on properties in France, Germany and Italy under the European Professional Card. Elsewhere, it acts as a broker with a licensed local agency and remains your single point of contact.

broker.answer: MAPA Property acts as an international real estate broker for clients buying or selling outside Luxembourg. Elsewhere, regulated acts are carried out by a licensed local agency that it selects, and MAPA Property remains your single point of contact through to signing.
broker.faq_q1: What does an international real estate broker do?
broker.faq_a1: It defines the requirement precisely, identifies the properties, chooses the right local partner, oversees the file and remains the client's single point of contact through to signing.
broker.faq_q2: In which countries does MAPA Property operate?
broker.faq_a2: Directly in Luxembourg, and in France, Germany and Italy under the European Professional Card. Elsewhere, on request, with licensed local agencies; the Active markets page shows the regular coverage.
broker.faq_q3: Who carries out the transaction abroad?
broker.faq_a3: In France, Germany and Italy, MAPA Property can conduct it itself. In other countries, negotiation and the transaction are carried out by a licensed local agency that represents the client on the ground.
broker.faq_a4: For a search in Europe, including France, 3% to 8% excluding VAT of the purchase price depending on complexity and country. Outside Europe, quoted in the mandate.

value_opinion.title: MAPA Property value opinion
value_opinion.subtitle: Value established by cross-checking several valuation methods
value_opinion.not_expertise: This document is a value opinion. It is not a real estate expert appraisal and does not replace an expert's report: it cannot be relied upon by a third party (bank, authority, court).
value_opinion.footer: MAPA Property, a brand of MAPA Synergy Sàrl · Value opinion
value_opinion.scope_p1: This opinion estimates the market value of the property described on the next page, that is, the price at which it could reasonably be sold on the open market at the issue date, between a willing and informed seller and buyer.
value_opinion.scope_p2: The value is established by cross-checking several valuation methods, each presented with its principle, its result and its real weight in the synthesis.
value_opinion.scope_p3: The characteristics used are those recorded in the file. They have not been checked against documents (title deed, land register, planning, co-ownership rules, surveys).
value_opinion.scope_p4: This opinion is valid at its issue date: changes in the market or in the property may alter its conclusion.
value_opinion.market_reference: Reference price per sq m in the municipality
value_opinion.market_adjusted: Price per sq m after adjustments
value_opinion.market_rent: Market rent per sq m per month
value_opinion.market_comparables_median: Median price per sq m of comparable sales
value_opinion.market_none: No quantified market data is recorded for this file.
value_opinion.methods_intro: Each applicable method produces a value. Its real weight is its share in the synthesis; a method that does not apply weighs 0%.
value_opinion.p_observatoire: Reference price per sq m of the municipality, adjusted by coefficients specific to the property (condition, energy performance, floor, layout, size), plus outbuildings. For a house: value of the building and value of the land.
value_opinion.p_sales_comparison: Median price per sq m of recorded comparable sales (same municipality, same type of property), after excluding outliers, applied to the living area.
value_opinion.p_hedonic: Base price per sq m corrected by a coefficient for each characteristic (condition, energy, year, floor, lift, exposure, view, size), then any added value for terrace, parking and works.
value_opinion.p_income_capitalization: Estimated annual market rent for the property, divided by a market yield, within the Luxembourg legal rent cap.
value_opinion.p_depreciated_replacement: Value of the land, plus the cost of rebuilding new, less depreciation.
value_opinion.p_statec_reference: Average reference price of the municipality, with simple adjustments (condition, energy, year of construction, size).
value_opinion.synthesis_per_sqm: Per sq m of living area
value_opinion.synthesis_weighted: Weighted value of the methods, before rounding
value_opinion.synthesis_text: The value retained reflects the real weight of each method. The range expresses the uncertainty inherent in any valuation; the sale price will also depend on negotiation and market conditions.
value_opinion.a1: The property is assumed to be vacant, unless stated otherwise in the file.
value_opinion.a2: The property is assumed to comply with planning and building rules, with no undeclared easement or charge.
value_opinion.a3: No pollution, asbestos or hidden defect is assumed beyond what the file shows.
value_opinion.a4: Areas are taken as declared, without certified measurement.
value_opinion.a5: No acquisition costs, registration duties or fees are included in the value.
value_opinion.a6: The market data used is that available at the issue date.
